text: "We're singin' to kape our breakfasts down. Ye'll lead, av course, Disko," said Long Jack. "Guess there ain't more'n 'baout two old songs I know, an' ye've heerd them both." His excuses were cut short by Tom Platt launching into a most dolorous tune, like unto the moaning of winds and the creaking of masts. With his eyes fixed on the beams above, Disko began this ancient, ancient ditty, Tom Platt flourishing all round him to make the tune and words fit a little: "There is a crack packet--crack packet o' fame, She hails from Noo York, an' the Dreadnought's her name.
